chars.SISTERINLAW: THE BROTHER'S WIFE: a Moroccan woman about 28, long dark hair under a loosely tied burgundy headscarf, wearing a bright mustard-yellow house kaftan with small white embroidery, gold hoop earrings
chars.NARRATOR: THE NARRATOR: a Moroccan man about 30, short black hair, short black beard, wearing an olive-green zip hoodie and beige chinos
chars.MOM: MOM: a Moroccan countryside woman about 60, wearing a navy-blue djellaba and a white headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Night, inside a simple rural Moroccan house living room with low sedari sofas and a dim lamp. Seen from the doorway, head-to-waist: THE BROTHER'S WIFE stands very close to THE NARRATOR, holding his sleeve with one hand, teary pleading eyes, confessing her feelings; THE NARRATOR leans back, eyes wide in shock. Her face fully visible. Subjects centered, calm dark edges, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Close head-to-waist shot of THE BROTHER'S WIFE at night in a dim rural Moroccan living room, tears on her cheeks, hand pressed on her chest, looking up longingly and hurt. Subject centered, calm edges, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Night, rural Moroccan living room. THE NARRATOR steps back with one palm raised to stop her, angry and shocked face; THE BROTHER'S WIFE in the background, seen from behind and slightly to the side, reaching toward him. Narrator's face visible in the center, calm edges, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. THE NARRATOR alone, frozen in shock, both hands gripping his head, mouth open, sweating, standing in a dark rural Moroccan courtyard at night under a single bulb. Head-to-waist, subject centered, calm edges, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: 2D cartoon illustration, vertical. Night, the narrator's family house in the Moroccan countryside: THE NARRATOR walks in through a blue metal door, pale and shaken, avoiding eye contact; MOM stands up from a low sofa, worried, reaching out to him. Both faces visible, subjects centered, calm edges, no text.
